title: Native run of loader-diag-xnu-us1-md1 (NAT-130: sc9 + NAT-130 USB engine) with the NAT-130 delivery companion: measure the USB 2.0 root-delivery phases on the phone (host sum, wire, device sum per mode, gaps), the A/B of checksum modes on chunk 0, total rate and integrity; then the usual sc9 userland/display observables; restore stock RECOVERY and check Android
acceptance: Exactly one bounded run of the pinned us1 package, RECOVERY write with full readback, archive and delivery record collected
Delivery outcome, device-committed bytes, every chunk's sum verified (commit or post-verify), per-phase times and per-mode device ticks reported from the device's own numbers
Stock RECOVERY restored with full hash match; Android boot_completed and user-data directories present
Dated native evidence; a speed-up is claimed only from measured device-committed bytes over measured time
